title: Dynamic defensive security tests - Ganaderia AI

tests.objective: Verify that the application database role follows least privilege.
tests.control_expected: Application role is not superuser and cannot create roles/databases.

tests.objective: Reject access to an authenticated endpoint without a session.
tests.control_expected: GET /api/auth/me returns 401.

tests.objective: Register a synthetic user with a strong password.
tests.control_expected: Registration returns the generic 202 response.

body.message: Si los datos son validos, el registro fue procesado. Ya puedes intentar iniciar sesion.

tests.objective: Prevent role mass assignment during registration.
tests.control_expected: Requested admin role is ignored and stored role remains usuario.

tests.objective: Avoid account enumeration through duplicate registration.
tests.control_expected: New and duplicate registration responses are indistinguishable.

tests.objective: Reject malformed email addresses.
tests.control_expected: Registration returns 400 INVALID_EMAIL.

tests.objective: Enforce a production-grade password policy.
tests.control_expected: A six-character password is rejected as weak.

tests.objective: Return indistinguishable errors for unknown users and wrong passwords.
tests.control_expected: Both attempts return the same 401 code and message.

tests.objective: Set hardened session-cookie attributes.
tests.control_expected: Cookie is HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict; Secure is environment-aware on local HTTP.

tests.objective: Reject a tampered encrypted session cookie.
tests.control_expected: Tampered cookie returns 401 without technical details.

tests.objective: Invalidate a captured session token after logout.
tests.control_expected: Replaying the pre-logout cookie is rejected.

tests.objective: Rotate or revoke older sessions when the same account logs in again.
tests.control_expected: Session policy explicitly controls concurrent tokens; older token should not remain silently valid for high-risk use.

tests.objective: Handle malformed JSON without leaking internals.
tests.control_expected: 400 response does not contain stack traces, SQL, or local paths.

tests.objective: Expose baseline browser-security headers.
tests.control_expected: CSP, frame denial, nosniff, referrer, permissions, COOP/CORP are present and framework fingerprint is absent.

tests.objective: Block unsafe cross-origin requests.
tests.control_expected: Foreign Origin receives 403.

tests.objective: Do not trust client-supplied forwarded host metadata for CSRF decisions.
tests.control_expected: Spoofed X-Forwarded-Host cannot make a foreign Origin appear same-origin.

tests.objective: Reject arbitrary Host headers in the development server.
tests.control_expected: An unrelated Host is blocked.

tests.objective: Avoid a broad wildcard for shared Cloudflare development hostnames.
tests.control_expected: An arbitrary *.trycloudflare.com Host is not accepted by the Vite development server.

tests.objective: Mark authenticated data as non-cacheable by shared intermediaries.
tests.control_expected: Sensitive GET responses include private/no-store cache policy.

tests.objective: Keep diagnostic API routes private.
tests.control_expected: Unauthenticated diagnostic endpoint is absent or requires authentication.

tests.objective: Do not let callers choose the trusted client IP header directly.
tests.control_expected: Changing CF-Connecting-IP outside a trusted proxy does not reset the same caller's rate-limit bucket.

tests.objective: Create a valid bovino without accepting a caller-supplied identifier or owner.
tests.control_expected: Endpoint creates a user-scoped bovino and generates its arete.

tests.objective: Prevent user A from accessing user B resource through GET /api/bovinos/2.
tests.control_expected: Cross-account access returns 403 or 404 and does not mutate the target.

tests.objective: Prevent user A from accessing user B resource through PUT /api/bovinos/2.
tests.control_expected: Cross-account access returns 403 or 404 and does not mutate the target.

tests.control_expected: Cross-account access returns 403 or 404 and does not mutate the target.

tests.objective: Restrict community conversation reads to participants.
tests.control_expected: Outsider receives 404.

tests.objective: Restrict community conversation writes to participants.
tests.control_expected: Outsider cannot send a message.

tests.objective: Reject a user_id mismatch in the non-streaming AI evaluator.
tests.control_expected: Authenticated user A cannot evaluate as user B.

tests.objective: Prevent a regular user from editing a global breed.
tests.control_expected: Regular user receives 403.

tests.objective: Allow an administrator to maintain the global breed catalog.
tests.control_expected: Admin update succeeds.

tests.objective: Limit authenticated user-directory search to minimum necessary personal data.
tests.control_expected: Broad one-term search does not enumerate other users' full email addresses.

tests.objective: Reject negative weights.
tests.control_expected: Negative value returns 400.

tests.objective: Reject physically implausible bovine weights.
tests.control_expected: An extreme 999999 kg value is rejected.

tests.objective: Apply a consistent maximum length to memory creation.
tests.control_expected: A 6000-character memory is rejected before embedding/database work.

tests.objective: Handle SQL metacharacters as data in directory search.
tests.control_expected: Query is parameterized and causes neither SQL error nor bulk disclosure.

tests.objective: Block a direct prompt-injection attempt.
tests.control_expected: Evaluator marks request blocked and does not execute business tools.

route.reason: El guardrail detecto una instruccion potencialmente peligrosa.

tests.objective: Reject an arbitrary SQL execution request.
tests.control_expected: Request is blocked and no SQL tool is executed.

tests.objective: Prevent direct execution of unapproved owner-creation tools.
tests.control_expected: crearDueno is refused and no owner row is inserted.

tests.objective: Require confirmation/orchestration before a caller invokes a write tool.
tests.control_expected: Supplying direct_tool cannot create a business record directly.

tests.objective: Keep tool reads scoped to the authenticated account.
tests.control_expected: User A cannot retrieve user B bovino through direct tool arguments.

tests.objective: Prevent cross-user RAG retrieval from semantic_contexts tied to another bovino.
tests.control_expected: User A retrieved_context does not contain user B marker.

route.reason: La pregunta es explicativa y pertenece al dominio ganadero.

tests.objective: Require an explicit public classification before sharing unowned semantic context.
tests.control_expected: A semantic_contexts row with bovino_id NULL is not automatically global to every user.

route.reason: La pregunta es explicativa y pertenece al dominio ganadero.

tests.objective: Minimize or redact raw AI prompts at rest.
tests.control_expected: Unique prompt marker is not persisted in plaintext in ai_logs.

tests.objective: Keep current ownership unchanged while a transfer is pending.
tests.control_expected: Owner remains user A until user B accepts.

tests.objective: Allow only the destination user to accept a transfer.
tests.control_expected: Source user cannot accept its own outgoing request.

tests.objective: Atomically move bovino ownership only after destination acceptance.
tests.control_expected: Accepted transfer changes owner to user B and source loses direct CRUD access.

tests.objective: Do not transfer user-authored personal memories implicitly with bovino ownership.
tests.control_expected: Linked memory remains with source, is redacted, or requires explicit consent/classification.

tests.objective: Limit former owners to the portion of transfer history relevant to them.
tests.control_expected: User A cannot see later B-to-admin identities after its ownership ended.

tests.objective: Redact sensitive AI observability fields for regular users.
tests.control_expected: Regular user receives only own rows and sensitive details are null/redacted.
